## Problem

> [!TIP]
> Describe the current problem, challenge or risk in concrete terms.
> **Ask:** _"What is the problem that needs to be solved?"_

## Solution

> [!TIP]
> Describe the proposed approach, including important constraints.
> **Ask:** _"How do you imagine solving this problem?"_

## Value

> [!TIP]
> Explain why the outcome matters now, for users and for maintainers.
> **Ask:** _"What are you hoping to achieve?"_

## Deliverables

- [ ] Deliverable 1
- [ ] Deliverable 2

## Acceptance criteria

> [!TIP]
> For anything in Varve's scope this usually includes a W3C suite. A feature
> shipped with no suite behind it is a defect the 3a close-out found by name.

- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2

## Fit

- [ ] It fits the layering in `docs/adr/0003-package-layering.md`
- [ ] It works on all three hosts — embedded, server, browser — or says which it does not and why
- [ ] It needs no native dependency and no reflection
- [ ] A W3C suite covers it, or it is specified in `docs/spec/`
- [ ] It needs an ADR first

> [!NOTE]
> Which milestone in `docs/roadmap.md` does this belong to? If it belongs to
> none, say so — that is an argument for a new one, not against the request.
